items.name: Composite Shortbow
items.description: This shortbow is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Its compact size and power make it a favorite of mounted archers. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a shortbow, it also applies to composite shortbows unless otherwise stated.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Thieves' Tools (Infiltrator)
items.description:
You need thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Pick a Lock]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Disable a Device]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thieves' Toolkit (Infiltrator Picks)]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action. If you wear your thieves' tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: The razorclaw isn't Off-Guard to creatures of 13th level or lower that are Hidden, Undetected, flanking, or using Surprise Attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Adamantine Edges
offensiveAbilities.description: The ghoul's claws have been dipped in adamantine. The razorclaw treats any object they hit with a claw Strike as if it had half as much Hardness and any creature they hit as if they had half as much physical resistance.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 7d6 Healing Damage Hit Points.

It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ghoul Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 31 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 4d6 Void Damage damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 4d6 Void Damage damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Ghoul the next midnight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a DC 31 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The ghoul razorclaw deals an extra 3d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise Attacker
offensiveAbilities.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are Off-Guard to the ghoul razorclaw.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swift Leap
offensiveAbilities.description: The ghoul razorclaw jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
